items.exampleEn: That dude in the red hat is my cousin.
items.exampleZh: 戴紅帽子的那個傢伙是我表哥。

items.exampleEn: She has known the groom since they were children.
Are you engaged? I see a ring on your finger.
items.exampleZh: 你訂婚了嗎？我看到你手指上戴著戒指。

items.exampleEn: My neighbor is an Englishman who loves Taiwanese food.
items.exampleZh: 我的鄰居是個熱愛台灣美食的英國人。

items.exampleEn: In business, a handshake often means the deal is done.
items.exampleZh: 在商場上，握手通常代表交易談成了。

items.exampleEn: Good teamwork helped us finish early.
items.exampleZh: 良好的團隊合作讓我們提早完成。

items.exampleEn: The old song is about peace and brotherhood.
items.exampleZh: 這首老歌講的是和平與兄弟情誼。

items.exampleEn: Shops can't sell alcohol to underage customers.
items.exampleZh: 商店不能賣酒給未成年的顧客。

items.sentenceEn: The bride and groom danced together in the garden.
items.sentenceZh: 新娘和新郎在花園裡一起跳舞。

items.audioEn: My brother and his girlfriend got engaged last night, and the wedding is in June.
items.audioZh: 我哥哥和他女朋友昨晚訂婚了，婚禮在六月。

items.sentenceEn: He greeted each guest with a firm handshake.
items.sentenceZh: 他和每位客人有力地握手打招呼。

items.sentenceEn: Teamwork is more important than one star player.
items.sentenceZh: 團隊合作比一位明星球員更重要。

items.stemEn: You must be eighteen to enter; ____ visitors are not allowed.
items.stemZh: 必須年滿十八歲才能進入，未成年的訪客不得入內。

items.stemEn: The two players ended the game with a ____.
items.stemZh: 兩位選手以握手結束了比賽。

items.passageEn: Last month, my old classmate Ben got married. The groom wore a dark blue suit, and he was very nervous. His best friend from college, an Englishman named Harry, gave a funny speech. "Hey, dude, don't worry!" he shouted, and everyone laughed. Ben and Harry played on the same football team in college, and the brotherhood of that team is still strong. Harry said their teamwork on the field was essential, and it taught them a lot about friendship. At the end, he gave Ben a warm handshake.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我的老同學 Ben 結婚了。新郎穿著深藍色西裝，非常緊張。他大學時最好的朋友——一位名叫 Harry 的英國人——致了一段有趣的詞。他大喊：「嘿，老兄，別緊張！」大家都笑了。Ben 和 Harry 大學時在同一支足球隊踢球，那支球隊的兄弟情誼至今依然深厚。Harry 說，他們在球場上的團隊合作非常重要，也讓他們學到很多關於友誼的事。最後，他和 Ben 熱情地握了手。

options: 新郎大學時最好的朋友
婚禮請來的專業主持人

questions.questionZh: Ben 和 Harry 大學時一起做什麼？

items.promptZh: 他們訂婚兩年後才結婚。
referenceEn: They were engaged for two years before they got married.
They got married after being engaged for two years.
rubricZh: be engaged 表示「已訂婚」，get engaged 表示「訂婚」這個動作
時態配合內容（例如 were engaged、got married、will get married）

items.instructionZh: 用 teamwork 造一個句子，說說團隊合作在你的工作、學校或運動中的重要性。
referenceEn: Teamwork is very important in my job.
Our class won the contest because of good teamwork.
rubricZh: teamwork 是不可數名詞，不加 a，也不加 s
可用 good teamwork、because of teamwork 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 my job、our class）
